title: fix(mobile): swipe-to-delete styling, back button layout, and admin message deletion
body:
## Summary of Changes

- **Swipe-to-Delete Button Rounded Edges**: Updated `SwipeToDelete.tsx` with `containerStyle={{ borderRadius: radius.tile, overflow: 'hidden' }}` and rounded action button corners matching the 22px tile design system.
- **Transparent Back Button**: Removed solid chip background overlay (`backgroundColor: c.room.chip`) from `V2Screen`'s `← Back` pressable in `Widget.tsx`.
- **Header Spacing**: Added explicit `marginRight: 4` and `gap: 12` spacing between `← Back` and the title in `Widget.tsx` and `ChatThreadScreen.tsx`.
- **Admin Conversation Room Deletion**: Re-exported `deleteChatRoom` in mobile data wrapper and wired `onDeleteForEveryone` on `MessagesScreen.tsx` & `MemberMessagesScreen.tsx` so full-timers / room creators delete room documents from Firestore for everyone upon confirmation.
- **Specific Message Deletion**: Exported `deleteChatMessage` in `@cisa/core` and mobile wrapper, and added long-press message deletion for admins / full-timers and authors in `ChatThreadScreen.tsx`.
- **Tests & Changelog**: Added unit tests in `packages/core/test/chat.test.ts` and `apps/mobile/src/components/messages/SwipeToDelete.test.tsx`, and updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.
